lcc_original: 於是把那人趕逐出去，又在伊甸園東邊安設【7】基路伯拿着發火燄的旋轉劍，來把守生命樹的路。
notes: 那人 (LCC) maps to 他 (UNV), both = WH0120 (הָאָדָם); LCC is more explicit ('that person') while UNV uses a pronoun
趕逐出去 (LCC) = 趕出去了 (UNV) for WH01644+WTH8762; UNV's aspect particle 了 is correctly unannotated in the original

UNV's 和<WAH0853> (= וְאֵת, conjunction+object-marker for the sword) has no explicit Chinese counterpart in LCC — the sentence restructures cherubim as agent holding the sword; WAH0853 kept implicit as {<WAH0853>} inserted before 拿着
LCC's 拿着 ('holding') is an interpretive addition with no Hebrew equivalent (no such verb in Hebrew text); left unannotated
UNV's 四面轉動 and LCC's 旋轉 both translate WH02015+WTH8693 (הַמִּתְהַפֶּכֶת, the rotating/turning one); LCC collapses the adverbial '四面' into the single word 旋轉
發火燄 (LCC) = 發火焰 (UNV), both for WH03858 (לַהַט, flame); LCC uses variant character 燄 vs UNV's 焰
LCC's 的路 = UNV's 的道路, both for WH01870 (דֶּרֶךְ, way/path)
來 (LCC purpose marker) covers the ל- infinitive prefix WAH09001 that UNV renders as 要; tagged together as 來把守<WAH09001><WH08104><WTH8800>
【7】 footnote marker preserved in original position between 安設 tags and {<WAH0853>}基路伯
